transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this case conference under our pre-filing practice. As we all know, a former sales executive left last week and joined a direct competitor, and we believe confidential customer information may have been used since their departure. We're looking at a potential preliminary-injunction hearing that could be requested within three weeks, and the draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Before I can sign off on the filing decision, I need each of you to report any material issues on your end. Let's start with employment counsel, then forensics, then insurance. Please go ahead.
